infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IrriTrack uses the camera to verify your identity and capture project checklist photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: IrriTrack uses Face ID to unlock your saved session on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IrriTrack uses your location while you work to record site coordinates, update node locations, and add location details to checklist photos.
